speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) secondary to viral illness or garlic-induced vestibular irritation. The patient's description of a sustained, low-grade spinning sensation with nausea, lack of focal neurological deficits, and partial relief with antihistamines points towards a peripheral vestibular etiology. Given the recent cold and garlic intake, I will rule out other causes. Do you experience any worsening of dizziness when rolling over in bed or looking up?
